title: Step 70-E Transfer Reservation Allocation and Sale Consumption administration
description: Implement HIGH-risk Admin inventory flow administration for AD-D-08, AD-D-09 and AD-D-10, plus the minimal canonical contract correction required to align late-payment-review with its existing runtime RequireIdempotency('inventory.convert') authority. Reuse generated request types, server-owned idempotency where runtime requires it, fail-closed unknown outcomes, scope-safe reads and Persian RTL workflows. Do not mutate Backend runtime/database/Product Design/Storefront/Current-State/Step71.

transfer_invariants: source and destination warehouses must differ
variant IDs are unique within a transfer
reservation_invariants: expiry must be a valid future datetime
payment grace when present must be at or after expiry
online sellable stock remains Backend authority
late payment review may reclaim released stock only when available
converted reservation commitment release preserves stock-balance consistency
allocation_invariants: reservation-backed allocation cannot exceed remaining converted reservation commitment
sale consumption requires picked allocation and consumes FIFO/COGS before shipped status
evidence.read_contract_limit: Canonical generated GET responses for these inventory flow views do not expose typed response bodies. Stage70-E must not bypass generated authority or invent response shapes; read surfaces report source-backed endpoint/status/request-id only.

evidence.design_provenance_repair: Canonical CI/Phase A failed closed after the authorized late-payment-review OpenAPI idempotency correction because Step56/57 recovered-source evidence pins mutable source SHA256 values. Stage70-E authorizes only the canonical generator-equivalent source-hash cascade on the 17 explicitly listed Product Design provenance files. No screen, journey, operation, permission, visual, review-status, approval, runtime-release or business semantics may change.

acceptance_criteria.description: Stage70-E reuses createAdminAuthBridge and canonical generated request schemas; no raw Admin credential authority or parallel API client is introduced.
Only the five frozen source-backed reads are exposed. Because canonical GET responses are untyped, UI does not invent transfer/reservation/allocation record shapes.
Exactly the eight runtime-required idempotent mutations receive server-owned fresh Idempotency-Key values. Browser input cannot supply or alter those keys.

The nine runtime mutations without RequireIdempotency do not invent idempotency or automatic replay. Network/timeout/aborted/5xx is treated as unknown outcome for every mutation and requires authoritative re-read before another action.

Transfer create validation matches runtime: distinct source/destination, non-empty unique variant items and positive integer quantities. State-transition/FIFO/source-stock authority remains Backend-owned.

Reservation validation matches runtime: future expiry, grace not before expiry, unique warehouse+variant pairs and positive integer quantities. Reservation state transitions and late-payment stock reclaim remain Backend-owned.

Allocation validation matches runtime: required order-item/warehouse/variant UUIDs, positive integer quantity and optional reservation UUID. Pick/unpick/release/consume-sale are exposed only through canonical operations.

No Inventory adjustment/warehouse-protection, Procurement/POS, Backend runtime/database/Product Design/Storefront/Current-State/Step71/Graph mutation is added. The only contract mutation is the source-proven late-payment-review Idempotency-Key correction in canonical OpenAPI and generated TypeScript.
Admin canonical verify includes a deterministic Step70-E verifier and preserves inherited Step67-70-D verification.

HIGH-risk closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, CodeQL/Independent Security, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock and explicit Project Owner Human Gate before protected merge; exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release complete before 70-F.

Recovered Step56/57 provenance drift caused only by the authorized late-payment-review OpenAPI correction is synchronized through generator-equivalent source SHA/manifest/final-audit/high-fidelity hash propagation on the 17 explicitly listed Product Design provenance files; no design semantics or historical verdicts change.
